{{Top|leg}}
"'''Demonstration fleet'''" was a term used after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] to describe warships produced under a legal exemption granted to [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers. This exemption, introduced when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] ordered limits on regional fleets as part of the Ruusan Reformations, allowed shipbuilders to design and construct prototype or experimental variants of existing starship classes. The intent was to encourage technological innovation and the development of local [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In practice, however, this exemption was exploited by many [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] to acquire powerful fleets by leasing control of the prototype vessels from the manufacturers. By the final centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], wealthy sectors had fleets of leased starships.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />
